title: Set up cron job to scrape website for news sites, store in database. by viceinternet
text:
Set up cron job to scrape website for news sites, store in database. 
Hello 
For this project I want you to resurrect a project I have which scraped a variety of news sites and put a links in a database next to a stock ticker. The cron job should run every minute or two to get this information to keep it up to date. 
I then need you to make a page where I can enter a list of tickers, and you keep the page up to date from the newest data to the oldest (dynamically updating) based on that data. 
Each entry in the database will have a ticker, a timestamp and a URL and text (headline) associated with it 
e.g. (hypothetically) 
AAPL <timestamp> [url removed, login to view] Apple missed Q1 numbers 
On my display page I should be able to enter tickers such as 
APPL, [url removed, login to view], [url removed, login to view] 
and then get a chronologically feed of news from most recent to oldest (think Bloomberg feed) 
I worked on this project for a year or two ten years ago so I have some files I will share that might be useful. I want to set this up on a brand new linux server over at AWS. I will provide login details as well as login details to where the old data is. 
Thanks!
